dimensions.label: Diplomatic alignment
dimensions.measurement: Change in similarity of UN General Assembly voting on a fixed comparable resolution cohort

dimensions.label: Implemented agreements
dimensions.measurement: Change in independently verified implemented cross-border agreements, not announcements

dimensions.label: Institutional leadership
dimensions.measurement: Change in competitively elected leadership positions and documented voting support
requirements: Election record and vote totals where public
Term dates and comparable eligible institutions

dimensions.label: Diplomatic relationships
dimensions.measurement: Change in formal diplomatic relations established, restored, downgraded or severed
requirements: No duplicate counting of embassy openings

dimensions.label: Implemented mediation outcomes
dimensions.measurement: Change in independently confirmed implemented diplomatic settlements with documented mediator role

scoringRules.normalization: Pre-register common denominators and historical materiality targets before computing any component scores; no invented 0–100 conversion
scoringRules.missingness: Never redistribute weights, zero-fill missing components or calculate a composite from partial components
scoringRules.minimumEvidence: All five components require compatible baseline and follow-up, verifiable sources, cost/counterevidence review and calibration
scoringRules.independence: Same event may appear in evidence for multiple categories but may contribute to at most one scored category without a justified distinct outcome
scoringRules.attribution: Record direct actor role and alternative explanations; partner activity does not automatically count as actor influence
scoringRules.sensitivity: Compare baseline weights to equal weights and alternative weighting after component validation
scoringRules.scope: EU institutional diplomacy distinguished from individual EU member-state actions
scoringRules.unScoredDial: Needle hidden; never present center as zero influence
